svg.aria-label: Apogee VM v1.0.0, one end-to-end run on CPUs: 198M RISC-V cycles executed, 207 shards proved in 2,481 s on 32 vCPUs, a 1.03 MB root proof after recursion, and 3.62M gas to verify the final Groth16 proof on-chain.
